enchantments.tooltip: Hide +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Hide skill.
Move Silently +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Move Silently skill.
Deception +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to hit and +15 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Ghostly: Equipping this item causes you to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets. Enemy attacks have a 10% chance to miss you due to incorporeality. You receive a +5 enhancement bonus to your Hide and Move Silently skills.

Silent Avenger Set (Legendary): 3 Pieces Equipped:You gain a 15% Artifact Bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot.You gain +3 Artifact Bonus to Sneak Attack Dice.You gain a 30% Artifact Bonus to Fortification Bypass.You gain +15% Artifact Bonus to Damage vs. Helpless opponents.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
